title: Prove and prune a one-shot batched scalar-admission candidate
research_question: Can the current per-entry persisted-scalar contract be represented by one sequence-level admission owner while preserving accepted values, tropical normalization, tuple reuse, and first-error semantics across Boolean, Natural, Tropical, EvidenceDag, unsupported names, and list materialization?

result.reason: Semantic parity is a prerequisite but not sufficient evidence for a production optimization. The temporary mirror is removed after verification so the branch does not retain a second scalar-admission authority. A future production change requires a controlled retained timing/effect-size result rather than an unretained pytest micro-timing.

claim_boundaries: GPU-22 establishes focused semantic-candidate evidence only; it does not establish a production scalar-admission optimization.
The bounded pytest micro-timing is not retained and is not used for a speedup claim.
No constructor-wide or general CPU speedup is claimed.
No CUDA, Tensor Core, GPU, or memory-performance win is claimed.
No Tensor-vs-Forest, CrewAI, or AlphaEvolve benchmark win is claimed.
Repository collection success is not represented as a complete-suite test pass.
